title: HPE security advisory (AV26-951)
description: As of September 22, 2026, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
Analytics and Location Engine (ALE)
	Prior to or equal to 5.0.0.0

HPE Telco Service Orchestrator
	Prior to or equal to 5.6.0
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
